# FitTheFile

> FitTheFile makes any PDF or photo fit an upload limit: compress to 100KB, 50KB or any size, plus merge, split and convert. Free online PDF and image tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded to a server. No signup, no watermarks, no daily limits.

## Tools
- [Compress PDF](https://fitthefile.com/compress-pdf): Shrink PDF file size with an adjustable quality level. Free online PDF compressor — no signup, no watermarks.
- [Merge PDF](https://fitthefile.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one document. Drag and drop to reorder pages easily.
- [Split PDF](https://fitthefile.com/split-pdf): Extract pages from a PDF or split it into separate files. Select the pages you need.
- [JPG to PDF](https://fitthefile.com/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images to PDF. Combine multiple images into a single PDF document.
- [PDF to JPG](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to high-quality JPG images. Download each page as a separate image.
- [Image Compressor](https://fitthefile.com/image-compressor): Compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images with a quality slider. Reduce image file size instantly.
- [Image Converter](https://fitthefile.com/image-converter): Convert images to JPG, PNG or WebP, including BMP and GIF files. Free and fast format conversion.
- [Image Resizer](https://fitthefile.com/image-resizer): Resize images to any dimension. Set custom width and height or choose from social media presets.
- [Word to PDF](https://fitthefile.com/word-to-pdf): Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF. Text, headings, lists and tables carry over; complex layouts may shift.
- [Rotate PDF](https://fitthefile.com/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Fix scanned documents with wrong orientation.
- [PDF Watermark](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-watermark): Add text watermarks to your PDF files. Customize font size, opacity, position, and color.
- [PDF Page Numbers](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-page-numbers): Add page numbers to your PDF. Choose position, format, and starting number. Free and easy.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://fitthefile.com/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG or PNG format. Batch convert multiple files at once.
- [Image Crop](https://fitthefile.com/image-crop): Crop images with an interactive drag-and-drop editor. Aspect ratio presets for social media.
- [SVG to PNG](https://fitthefile.com/svg-to-png): Convert SVG vector files to PNG or JPG at any resolution. Scale up to 4x for high-res output.
- [HTML to PDF](https://fitthefile.com/html-to-pdf): Convert HTML code or web content to PDF. Paste your HTML and download a clean PDF document.
- [PDF Unlock](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-unlock): Remove password from PDF files. Enter the password you know and download an unlocked copy.

## Exam and visa upload tools
- [US Visa Photo Resizer — 600×600, Under 240KB (DS-160)](https://fitthefile.com/us-visa-photo-resizer): Make a square US visa photo at 600×600 pixels and under 240KB for the DS-160 and other uploads. Free, private, done in your browser. Requirements cited from: https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/visa-information-resources/photos/digital-image-requirements.html
- [IBPS Photo & Signature Resizer — 200×230, 140×60 px](https://fitthefile.com/ibps-photo-signature-resizer): Resize your photo to 200×230 px (20–50KB), signature to 140×60 px (10–20KB), thumb and declaration for IBPS and bank exam forms. Free, private. Requirements cited from: https://punjabandsind.bank.in/system/uploads/document/2150_2024101518104187881.pdf
- [India Visa Photo Resizer — Square JPEG, 10KB to 300KB](https://fitthefile.com/india-visa-photo-resizer): Make a square India visa photo as a JPEG between 350×350 and 1000×1000 pixels and 10–300KB for the online visa form. Free, private, in your browser. Requirements cited from: https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/visa/VSS_IMAGE.pdf
- [PAN Card Photo & Signature Resizer — 200 DPI, 20KB / 10KB](https://fitthefile.com/pan-card-photo-signature-resizer): Resize your PAN card photo to 3.5 × 2.5 cm (under 20KB) and signature to 2 × 4.5 cm (under 10KB) at 200 DPI for the Protean (NSDL) online form. Free, private. Requirements cited from: https://tin.tin.proteantech.in/pan/InstructionDSC.html

## Key facts
- All processing is client-side in the browser; files are never uploaded.
- Target-size tools output a file under the limit using 1 KB = 1000 bytes, so it fits portals that count either way.
- Target-size PDFs are rasterised (pages saved as images), so text in the result is not selectable.
- Free and ad-supported; no account, no watermark, no daily limit.
